description: This file contains handlers for the dashboard UI endpoints, including both summary and enhanced detailed views. It defines data structures for responses, caching mechanisms, and handler functions that gather and process data from storage and services to produce comprehensive dashboard metrics, trends, and insights.

classes.name: DashboardHandler
classes.description: Struct that provides handlers for dashboard operations, encapsulating storage, cache, and service dependencies.

classes.name: DashboardCache
classes.description: Implements 30-second caching for dashboard summary data to optimize performance.

classes.name: EnhancedDashboardCache
classes.description: Implements a time-range-aware cache with LRU eviction for detailed enhanced dashboard responses.

methods.name: GetDashboardSummaryHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler to serve a brief dashboard summary, utilizing caching for efficiency.

methods.name: GetEnhancedDashboardSummaryHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler to serve a detailed, time-range aware dashboard with optional comparison data, utilizing caching.

methods.name: buildEnhancedOverviewForRange
methods.description: Constructs an overview summary for a specified agent and execution dataset within a time range.

methods.name: buildExecutionTrendsForRange
methods.description: Generates execution trend data (per day/hour) over a specified time window.

methods.name: buildComparisonData
methods.description: Computes delta metrics between current and prior periods for key overview statistics.

methods.name: buildHotspotSummary
methods.description: Aggregates failure data by reasoner to identify top error contributors.

methods.name: buildActivityPatterns
methods.description: Creates a 7x24 heatmap of execution activity and error rates.

methods.name: buildWorkflowInsights
methods.description: Produces insights about workflows including top workflows, active runs, and lengthy executions.

methods.name: buildIncidentItems
methods.description: Extracts recent incident records (failed/cancelled timeouts) from executions.

methods.name: computeMedian
methods.description: Calculates the median of a slice of execution duration values.

methods.name: maxTime
methods.description: Returns the later of two time points.

methods.name: getAgentsSummary
methods.description: Collects count of total and actively running agents.

methods.name: getExecutionsSummaryAndSuccessRate
methods.description: Gathers execution stats for today and yesterday, computes success rate.

methods.name: calculateSuccessRate
methods.description: Calculates success percentage from a set of execution records.

methods.name: getPackagesSummary
methods.description: Counts available and installed agent packages based on configurations.
